description: This file defines the Application class, a cross-platform application framework for managing application lifecycle, event handling, and state transitions within the Starboard environment. It includes methods for controlling application states, event scheduling, and handling media frames, along with lifecycle hooks for subclasses.

classes.name: Application
classes.description: A framework class for managing application lifecycle, event dispatching, and state transitions in a cross-platform environment.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the Application class.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the application event loop, dispatching initialization and teardown events.

methods.name: GetCommandLine
methods.description: Retrieves the command line parameters for the application.

methods.name: Blur
methods.description: Signals the application to transition to the BLURRED state.

methods.name: Focus
methods.description: Signals the application to transition to the STARTED state.

methods.name: Conceal
methods.description: Signals the application to transition to the CONCEALED state.

methods.name: Reveal
methods.description: Signals the application to transition from CONCEALED to STARTED.

methods.name: Freeze
methods.description: Signals the application to transition to the FROZEN state.

methods.name: Unfreeze
methods.description: Signals the application to transition from FROZEN to CONCEALED.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Gracefully terminates the application, transitioning through states as needed.

methods.name: Link
methods.description: Injects a link event with specified link data.

methods.name: InjectLowMemoryEvent
methods.description: Injects a low memory warning event.

methods.name: InjectOsNetworkDisconnectedEvent
methods.description: Injects a network disconnected event.

methods.name: InjectOsNetworkConnectedEvent
methods.description: Injects a network connected event.

methods.name: WindowSizeChanged
methods.description: Injects a window size change event.

methods.name: Schedule
methods.description: Schedules an event to occur after a specified delay.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Cancels a previously scheduled event.

methods.name: HandleFrame
methods.description: Handles a new video frame received from the media system.

methods.name: RegisterTeardownCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback to be invoked during application teardown.

methods.name: CreateInitialEvent
methods.description: Creates an initial start or preload event with command line and deep link.

methods.name: RunLoop
methods.description: Main loop processing events.

methods.name: HandleEventAndUpdateState
methods.description: Processes an event and updates application state accordingly.

methods.name: SetCommandLine
methods.description: Sets command line parameters for the application.

methods.name: SetStartLink
methods.description: Sets the deep link string for application start.

methods.name: IsCurrentThread
methods.description: Checks if the current thread is the application thread.

methods.name: state
methods.description: Returns the current application state.

methods.name: error_level
methods.description: Returns the last error level set by Stop().

methods.name: IsStartImmediate
methods.description: Determines if Start event should be dispatched immediately.

methods.name: DispatchStart
methods.description: Dispatches a Start event synchronously.

methods.name: IsPreloadImmediate
methods.description: Determines if Preload event should be dispatched immediately.

methods.name: DispatchPreload
methods.description: Dispatches a Preload event synchronously.

methods.name: HasPreloadSwitch
methods.description: Checks if '--preload' command-line argument is present.

methods.name: DispatchAndDelete
methods.description: Dispatches an event and deletes it after processing.

methods.name: CallTeardownCallbacks
methods.description: Invokes all registered teardown callbacks.
